control_state: planned: no circuit wires, no enable/disable condition
expected_behavior: A straight fast-transport-belt carries at most 30 items/s across both lanes and 15 items/s per lane, matching prototype speed 0.0625 tiles/tick x 480. transport-belt is 15/s (7.5 per lane) and express is 45/s (22.5 per lane).
notes: Two independent documented sources agree: the prototype docs give the speed x 480 formula and the wiki's physics page lists 15 items/s per lane for the fast belt.
No controlled game capture has been run for this checkout: task 02 had no Factorio installation or disposable save available, so nothing was measured.
Documented-only is sufficient to state the rate but not to close the release gate; the routing profile still needs the observation.
observation_method: Planned (CAPTURE.md 4.1): a straight, saturated fast belt feeding one infinity chest through a loader-equivalent sink; count items removed over a fixed tick interval and divide by the interval.

supplied_items.source: planned: infinity chest set to provide iron plates without limit
